title: Tune-Up Visit Entitlement Under the HVAC Maintenance Agreements
content:
Under the HVAC Maintenance Agreements, a member's tune-up visits are granted per term, used by completed visits and lost when unused at the close of the term.

## Terms of the entitlement

**Grant.** At activation and at each renewal the term's allotment is granted: the level's visits per system per term for each enrolled system, one cooling tune-up when the level includes a cooling-season tune-up and one heating tune-up when the level includes a heating-season tune-up. The number of visits granted for the term is the level's visits per system per term multiplied by the number of systems enrolled.

**Seasons and spacing.** Cooling tune-ups are scheduled from the first through the last month of the level's cooling window, and heating tune-ups from the first through the last month of its heating window, and two tune-ups of the same system in a term are at least 120 calendar days apart.

**Status.** Tune-ups are performed only while the agreement status is active. The status is read from the company's agreement record.

**Use.** A completed tune-up uses one visit; a missed visit uses none but is billed the missed-appointment fee.

**Services at each completed visit.** Each completed visit includes the services the level's switches turn on: filters, condensate drain, refrigerant top-off up to the level's included pounds per system per term, coil cleaning, carbon monoxide test, thermostat calibration, water heater flush, indoor air quality check and UV lamp.

**Lapse.** When unused visits do not carry over on the level, unused visits lapse at term end, on cancellation and on expiry, and a lapsed visit is never refunded or credited.

**Booking hold.** New visits are not booked while any membership fee is more than 15 calendar days past due.

## Basis questions and answers

**How many visits does a hypothetical agreement with three enrolled systems receive on a level granting two visits per system per term?** Six visits for the term: two multiplied by three.

**Does a missed visit reduce the visits available?** No. A missed visit uses no visit; it is billed the missed-appointment fee instead.

**Can a tune-up be carried out on an agreement that is enrolled but not yet active?** No. Tune-ups are performed only while the agreement status is active.

**Are visits left unused at the end of a term paid back?** No. Where unused visits do not carry over, they lapse at term end, on cancellation and on expiry, and a lapsed visit is never refunded or credited.

## Spacing boundary (hypothetical dates)

| First tune-up of a system | Second tune-up of the same system in the term | Calendar days apart | Meets the 120-day spacing |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 28 October | 120 | Yes |
| 30 June | 27 October | 119 | No |

## Booking hold boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Unpaid membership fee due on | Day a new visit is sought | Days past due | Booking hold applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 16 April | 15 | No; the fee is not more than 15 days past due |
| 1 April | 17 April | 16 | Yes; new visits are not booked |
